manifest.name: dsh-api-cost-meter
manifest.description: Live API spend meter for DeepSeek Harness: today's cost and the open window's cost, pushed over SSE and priced from token usage.

readme.text:
简体中文 | [English](README.en.md)

在 DeepSeek Harness 的输入框下方加一行常驻读数，实时显示**今日**与**当前窗口**的 API 调用费用：

```
今日 ¥0.5488 · 本窗口 ¥0.1372
```

点击读数会在其上方浮出一个明细面板（`position: fixed`，不参与布局，所以对话与输入框不会位移），
列出分模型的费用、调用次数与输入 / 缓存命中 / 输出 token。点面板外、按 Esc 或再次点击读数即可关闭。

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-api-cost-meter
```

或在 Harness Web UI 的 **设置 → 插件 → 添加** 里粘贴包名 `dsh-api-cost-meter`。
装好后输入框下方即出现读数；若没有出现，刷新一次页面。

要求：DSH Web 界面（`dsh web`）。插件无第三方运行时依赖。

- **今日**：本机时区当天 00:00 起，所有会话（含子代理会话）的合计。
- **本窗口**：当前打开会话从第一条消息起的合计，切换会话即切换。

**实时**：Host 通过 SSE（`/plugin/cost-meter/stream`）在每次模型调用结束时立即推送一帧，前端不做高频轮询；
金额变化用 420ms 缓动滚动到位，不硬跳。模型调用进行中（`llm/stream` 在途）时，读数左侧会亮起一个呼吸小圆点
表示「正在生成」——**此时金额尚未计入**，因为费用要等该次调用返还 `usage` 才能结算。
SSE 不可用时前端自动退回 1.5 秒轮询。

每次模型调用都会在会话日志里留下一条 `assistant/message`，其 `usage` 记录
`inputTokens / cacheReadTokens / cacheWriteTokens / outputTokens`。插件按下面的官方价目
（人民币 / 百万 tokens）逐条结算后累加：

| 模型 | 缓存命中输入 | 缓存未命中输入 | 输出 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deepseek-flash` | 空闲 0.02 / 高峰 0.04 | 空闲 1 / 高峰 2 | 空闲 4 / 高峰 8 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | 空闲 0.15 / 高峰 0.30 | 空闲 4.5 / 高峰 9 | 空闲 13.5 / 高峰 27 |

- 高峰时段：北京时间周一至周五 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00；其余为空闲时段，价格减半。
  法定节假日未内置日历，按高峰计。
- `deepseek-v4-flash`、`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`、`deepseek-chat`、`deepseek-reasoner`
  按 `deepseek-flash` 计价。
- 价目来源：<https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/>（2026-11 抓取）。
  DeepSeek 调价后需更新 `index.js` 顶部的 `PRICES`。
- 未收录的模型仍统计 token 与调用次数，但费用记 0，并在读数旁以「未配置价格」提示模型名（不臆造价格）。

- **实时**：Host 订阅 `session/event`，只对 `assistant/message` 做 O(1) 累加。
- **历史**：插件加载时通过 `sessionPersistence` 从磁盘日志回填当天用量（最多最近 200 个会话，
  每个会话从日志尾部回读、遇更早事件即停），所以重启不会把当天已花的钱清零。会话在
  `session/created` 时也会补读，覆盖恢复/继续的旧会话。
- 同一事件用「每个目标各自的 seq 下界」去重，实时与回填不会重复计费。

插件只读本地会话日志，不向任何外部服务发送数据。Host 仅注册两条**只读**本机路由：

```
GET /plugin/cost-meter/state?sessionId=<SessionId>   # 单次快照（轮询兜底）
GET /plugin/cost-meter/stream?sessionId=<SessionId>  # SSE 推送
```

两者都只接受 `GET`、拒绝跨站请求（`sec-fetch-site` 非 same-origin 时返回 403），
响应里只有费用与 token 统计，不含任何对话内容。

- 只覆盖 `deepseek-flash` 与 `deepseek-v4-pro` 两档官方价目；其他模型显示 token 但不计价。
- 节假日日历未内置，法定节假日按高峰计价。
- 金额是**按 token 用量推算**的费用，不等于账单；实际扣费以 DeepSeek 平台账单为准。

```bash
npm pack --dry-run   # 查看发布内容
```

- Host 入口 `index.js`（纯 ESM，无依赖）：订阅事件、聚合、注册路由。
- Client 入口 `client.js`：`window.__ModuleLoader__.load` 注册到 `conversation.composer.dock`（id `cost-meter`，order 2）。
- 文案：`client.js` 内置 zh / zh-CN / en 字典；`locale/*.json` 是插件管理器中显示的标题与描述。
MIT

[简体中文](README.md) | English

A resident readout under the DeepSeek Harness composer showing live API spend for **today** and for the **open window**:

```
Today ¥0.5488 · This window ¥0.1372
```

Click the readout to open a floating breakdown (fixed-positioned, so the composer never shifts): per-model cost,
call count, and input / cached / output tokens. Close it by clicking outside, pressing Escape, or clicking the readout again.

```bash
dsh plugin add dsh-api-cost-meter
```

Or open **Settings → Plugins → Add** in the Harness Web UI and paste the package name `dsh-api-cost-meter`.
The readout appears under the composer; refresh the page once if it does not.

Requires the DSH Web UI (`dsh web`). No third-party runtime dependencies.

- **Today** — every session (subagent sessions included) since local midnight.
- **This window** — the currently open session, from its first message; it follows you when you switch sessions.

**Live**: the Host pushes a frame over SSE (`/plugin/cost-meter/stream`) the moment each model call lands; the page
does not poll frequently. Amounts ease over 420 ms instead of snapping. While a model call is in flight
(`llm/stream`), a breathing dot appears left of the readout — the amount is **not** counted yet, because cost is only
known once that call returns its `usage`. If SSE is unavailable the client falls back to 1.5 s polling.

Each model call leaves an `assistant/message` event in the session log whose `usage` carries
`inputTokens / cacheReadTokens / cacheWriteTokens / outputTokens`. The plugin prices each event with the official
DeepSeek rate card (CNY per 1M tokens) and sums them:

| Model | Cached input | Uncached input | Output |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `deepseek-flash` | idle 0.02 / peak 0.04 | idle 1 / peak 2 | idle 4 / peak 8 |
| `deepseek-v4-pro` | idle 0.15 / peak 0.30 | idle 4.5 / peak 9 | idle 13.5 / peak 27 |

- Peak hours: Beijing time, Monday–Friday 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00; everything else is idle (half price).
  Chinese public holidays are not in a built-in calendar and are priced as peak.
- `deepseek-v4-flash`, `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`, `deepseek-chat` and `deepseek-reasoner` are billed at the
  `deepseek-flash` rate.
- Rates: <https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing> (read 2026-11). When DeepSeek changes prices, update
  `PRICES` at the top of `index.js`.
- An unknown model still contributes tokens and calls but zero cost, and the readout flags it as "no price
  configured" instead of inventing a number.

- **Live**: the Host subscribes to `session/event` and does O(1) accumulation per `assistant/message`.
- **History**: on activation the plugin backfills today's usage from on-disk logs through `sessionPersistence`
  (the newest 200 sessions, each read from the tail until an older event is reached), so a restart does not wipe
  the day's spend. Sessions are also backfilled on `session/created`, covering resumed sessions.
- Deduplication uses a per-target sequence floor, so a live event and its stored copy are counted once.

The plugin only reads local session logs and sends nothing to any external service. The Host registers two
**read-only** loopback routes:

```
GET /plugin/cost-meter/state?sessionId=<SessionId>   # one snapshot (polling fallback)
GET /plugin/cost-meter/stream?sessionId=<SessionId>  # SSE push
```

Both accept `GET` only and reject cross-site requests (`sec-fetch-site` other than same-origin returns 403).
Responses contain cost and token aggregates only — never conversation content.

- Pricing covers only the `deepseek-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro` tiers; other models show tokens without cost.
- No holiday calendar: public holidays are priced as peak.
- The amount is an **estimate derived from token usage**, not a bill; the DeepSeek platform invoice is authoritative.

```bash
npm pack --dry-run   # inspect what would be published
```

- Host entry `index.js` (plain ESM, no dependencies): event subscription, aggregation, routes.
- Client entry `client.js`: registers into `conversation.composer.dock` (id `cost-meter`, order 2).
- Text: zh / zh-CN / en dictionaries in `client.js`; `locale/*.json` feeds the title and description shown in the
  Plugin Manager.
MIT
